name: gritive
description: Comprehensive codebase review plugin with backend, frontend, security, and conformance reviewers dispatched as read-only subagents. Includes a review-forever loop that wraps any review skill and iterates until its actionable queue is empty, persona-based UX testing, and a project skill that bootstraps a project from an RFP (PRD, design guide, GitHub issues), analyzes implementation gaps, and can burn down the issue backlog autonomously through merge and deploy.
